entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-14
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Perf regression: antiforgery-noop #64374
  • Get hot reload working reliably #64373
  • Mark all AddRazorRuntimeCompilation extension methods and related APIs as obsolete for consistent Razor runtime compilation deprecation in .NET 10 #64372
    11.0-preview1
  • OpenApi with parameter in route fails when parameter is not on action #64370
  • Blazor apps with .NET 10 and Docker deployment do not trigger events #64366
  • IUrlHelper depends on ActionContext obsoleted in ASP.NET Core 10 #64361
  • Blazor Web App with EntraID does not refresh auth after token expires #64360
  • Blazor WebAssembly Standalone template incorrectly fingerprints _framework runtime files when OverrideHtmlAssetPlaceholders=true (VS 2026 / .NET 10) #64359
  • asp.net core openapi xml comments not working on dynamically registered routes #64358
  • SignalR with Azure Entra ID authentication in Blazor Server impossible to use #64355

Closed

  • @microsoft/signalr 10.0.0 not published to npmjs.org #64367
  • Idea: Sponsor Blazor Design Competition with monetary rewards (because AI is bad at Blazor) #64344
